environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate with default container configuration. Container filesystem is read-write. Logback appender writes to /var/log/app/audit.log on a mounted EBS volume. CloudWatch agent tails the audit log file and indexes entries as structured events. SIEM correlation rules trigger on specific log patterns (e.g., 'ADMIN_ESCALATION', 'AUTH_BYPASS'). No input sanitization middleware configured.
